items.title: How AI is giving Northern Ireland teachers time back
items.summary: A six-month long pilot program with the Northern Ireland Education Authority’s C2k initiative found that integrating Gemini and other generative AI tools saved participating teachers an average of 10 hours per week.
items.summaryZh: Google DeepMind与北爱尔兰教育部门合作开展了为期六个月的试点项目，将Gemini及Google Workspace工具引入课堂。结果显示，参与教师每周平均节省10小时行政工作时间，并产生了超过600种创新应用场景。该项目证明了AI作为协作工具在减轻教师负担、提升教学效率方面的潜力，强调了AI在教育科学指导下对提升学生参与度的积极作用。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该试点项目量化了生成式AI在教育场景中的实际效率提升，为AI落地教育提供了实证参考。

items.title: Free ChatGPT for transitioning U.S. servicemembers and veterans
items.summary: OpenAI is offering U.S. servicemembers and veterans within 12 months of retirement or separation a free year of ChatGPT Plus to support their transition to civilian life. The tools can help with resumes, interviews, education, and planning for what’s next.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布为即将退役或离职的美国军人提供为期一年的免费ChatGPT Plus订阅。此举旨在帮助退伍军人利用AI工具进行简历优化、面试准备及职业规划。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于企业社会责任（CSR）范畴的福利赠送，不涉及模型技术或行业核心进展。
